name: Qwen3-8B
notes: Dense GQA, the baseline serving case - no MoE, no MLA, no hybrid attention. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 36 layers x 8 kv_heads x head_dim 128 x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes (bf16) = 36 x 8 x 128 x 2 x 2 = 147,456 B/token (144 KiB). head_dim 128 is explicit in config (and equals 4096/32). gqa_ratio 4. Params: safetensors total 8.19B; our arithmetic from config (hidden 4096, 36 layers, intermediate 12288, vocab 151936) gives 8.2B, matching. Context: max_position_embeddings 40960, rope_theta 1000000, rope_scaling null (native, no YaRN). Apache-2.0, which makes this the licence-easiest model in the slice - Qwen's older 2.5 line used the bespoke Qwen License Agreement, so 3.x is a real improvement for on-prem use. Thinking vs non-thinking is a serving mode (enable_think in the chat template), not a different architecture; the -2507 refresh is the same shape. Qwen3's hybrid thinking mode has no KV implication.
